newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington chief executive steps down.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington chief executive steps down.

text.p: British glassmaker Pilkington Plc said on Wednesday that Roger Leverton was stepping down as chief executive and that Paolo Scardini would take over the role.
Leverton said in a statement, "Trading conditions have been extremely difficult in certain of our key markets and results have been disappointing."
"The board felt that, under the circumstances, the next stage of the company's development should be handled by a new chief executive."

A Pilkington spokesman told Reuters, "the issue is that Roger(Leverton) was brought in to manage the cost base, he has taken a lot of cost out of the business and he has refocused the business but he has not done the costs quick enough or deep enough."
Scaroni is currently president of the Pilkington's automotive products world-wide division and joined the company in November 1996.
